title: Hanjie
source_topic: ICPC / The 2019 Asia Danang Regional Contest
statement: A nonogram board with at most six rows and six columns comes with a clue for every row and every column: the lengths, in order, of the maximal blocks of black cells in that line, with at least one white cell separating consecutive blocks. The task is to count the black-and-white colourings of the board that satisfy every row clue and every column clue simultaneously.
